_meta.notes: Counter-affidavit / reply affidavit by respondent. Para-wise admit/deny + new pleadings. Verification + affirmation mandatory.

title: Counter-Affidavit / Reply Affidavit (Respondent)
description: Respondent's reply to a writ petition / OA / suit / interlocutory application. Para-wise admission/denial of pleadings + additional pleadings of fact and law. Sworn before oath commissioner / notary.

para_wise_reply.label: Para-wise Reply (ad para 1, ad para 2 etc.)

mandatory_clauses.title: Cause Title
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Full cause title mirroring the petition: court name, case number, parties (petitioner vs respondent). Title: 'COUNTER-AFFIDAVIT ON BEHALF OF RESPONDENT NO. __'.

mandatory_clauses.title: Deponent Introduction
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: 'I, [name], aged about [X] years, S/o [father], R/o [address], do hereby solemnly affirm and state on oath as follows:'.

mandatory_clauses.title: Authority to Depose
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Para 1: deponent's capacity and authority to swear (officer of company / responsible person / party in person). Knowledge of facts asserted.

mandatory_clauses.title: Preliminary Objections
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: Para 2 onwards: maintainability, jurisdiction, limitation, non-joinder/mis-joinder, suppression of material facts, alternative remedy bar. Each as separate numbered para.

mandatory_clauses.title: Para-wise Reply
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: After preliminaries: 'Ad para [X] of the petition: the contents of para [X] of the petition are denied / admitted / not admitted and the petitioner is put to strict proof thereof.' Required for EVERY para of petition.

mandatory_clauses.title: Additional Pleadings on Merits
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: After para-wise reply: 'Without prejudice to the above, the respondent submits the following additional facts:' Numbered paras with positive case of respondent.

mandatory_clauses.title: Prayer
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: 'In view of the above, the respondent prays that the petition / suit may be dismissed with costs.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Verification Clause
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: 'Verified at [place] on [date] that the contents of paras [X to Y] of this counter-affidavit are true to my personal knowledge and the contents of paras [P to Q] are true based on records / information believed to be true and nothing material has been concealed. Signed: Deponent.'

mandatory_clauses.title: Attestation by Oath Commissioner / Notary
mandatory_clauses.content_guidance: 'Solemnly affirmed and signed before me on [date] at [place]. Identified by [advocate name]. Signature & Seal: Oath Commissioner / Notary Public.'

prompt_context.system_prompt_addendum: You are drafting a counter-affidavit / reply affidavit. CRITICAL: (1) Para-wise reply is MANDATORY — each para of the petition must be addressed (admit / deny / not admit / put to strict proof). (2) Standard formula: 'Ad para X: the contents of para X are denied. The petitioner is put to strict proof thereof.' or 'Ad para X: the contents are matters of record and require no reply.' (3) Preliminary objections (jurisdiction, limitation, maintainability, suppression) come BEFORE para-wise reply. (4) Additional pleadings on merits come AFTER para-wise reply. (5) Verification clause splits paras into 'true to personal knowledge' vs 'true on information and records'. (6) Deponent must be authorised to swear (officer of company / party / GPA holder). (7) Cite Order XIX CPC (affidavits) and applicable High Court Rules / SC Rules Order III for affidavit form.
prompt_context.tone: Defensive, denial-driven, factually anchored. Strict legal formality.
key_phrases: not admitted and the petitioner is put to strict proof

relevantActs: Order VI Rule 15 CPC (Verification of Pleadings)
filing_checklist: Counter-affidavit on stamp paper / proper paper as per HC Rules (some courts require Rs. 10 stamp)
Verified before oath commissioner / notary public
Para-wise reply to EVERY para of petition (no para skipped)
Documents annexed and marked as R-1, R-2, R-3 etc.
Vakalatnama filed (if not already on record)
Copy served on petitioner's counsel in advance
Affidavit of service of advance copy
Filed within time granted by court (extension application if delayed)
Index and synopsis (if HC Original Side / SC)

validation_rules.para_wise_reply_mandatory: WARN if para_wise_reply field does not contain at least one 'ad para' reference.
validation_rules.verification_clause_check: WARN if verification does not specify which paras are personal knowledge vs records.
validation_rules.deponent_authority: WARN if deponent_designation is generic ('officer') without specific authority basis for company / institutional respondent.
validation_rules.preliminary_before_merits: INFO — preliminary objections must appear before para-wise reply in final draft.
validation_rules.balanced_denial: INFO — avoid bare denial of every para; courts disfavour evasive denials (Order VIII Rule 5 CPC analogy).
